title: Four Pixel
description: Do you want a unique, challenging, and simple server? Well you come to the right place!
body:
# Four Pixel (4p)

### Simple • Unique • Challenging • Anarchy

Welcome to Four Pixel, a raw Minecraft survival experience. We’ve stripped the game down to its core: no mountains, no oceans, and no safety nets. Just you, a flat horizon, and a community of survivors.

## Why you should play this server?

This is what made 4pixel unique! Because you won't spawn in a regular world. Survival on a Permanent Superflat means every block is a prize and every resource is a battle.

- Pure Vanilla: No kits, no modded items, and no handouts.
  
- Villager Economy: With no ores in the ground, Villager Trading is your only path to power. Protect your trades, or lose your edge.
  
- Saturday Tree Parties: Every Saturday at the World Center, wood is replanted. It’s the pulse of the server—join the harvest or defend the forest.

## Features & Community
- DiscordSRV: Negotiate, roleplay, or declare war.
  
- Cross-Play (Geyser): Java and Bedrock players are both welcome.
  
- Content Creator Friendly: Whether you're a documentarian like Mogswamp or a chaotic raider, 4pixel is the perfect backdrop for your next video.
  

## The Code of Conduct

While we have no gameplay rules, we protect the integrity of the server. To keep the experience fair for everyone:
- No Lag Machines: Do not attempt to slow down the server.
  
- No Crash Exploits: Using crash books or any mechanic to force-quit other players is strictly forbidden.
  
- Hardware Respect: We play to have fun; don't use mechanics that make the game unplayable for others.


<details>
<summary>Server Details & FAQ</summary>

- Version: 1.21.1
  
- Schedule: The server is live every Weekend (Saturday & Sunday).
  
- Commands: We use EssentialsX for simple navigation: /tpa and /home.
  
- Note on Lag: We run on Aternos to keep the server free. If you experience lag, please check your ping or bear with us as we optimize the flatlands!


</details>
